note: Which committed artifact backs each published claim. The report reads this file. It used to take whichever filename sorted last in evidence/, which is not a selection criterion at all: adding certify-readme-sample.json would have silently moved the published certification figure off the intended control run, with no visible cause. Sorting by created_utc fails the same case, because the intended certify artifact is deliberately not the newest one. The choice has to be declared, so it is declared here.
selection_is_not_recency: certify names the max-num-seqs 8 control, which is neither the newest certify artifact nor the last by filename. Any rule derived from name or time picks a different file.

supporting.case-0003.json: the eviction finding, minimized and proven 1-minimal, pinned to the commit that closed it
supporting.case-witness.json: the replay-determinism witness the replay command re-runs
supporting.certify-0003.json: the default-mode positive control, 0 of 7 clean
supporting.certify-clean-revision.json: the filed finding reproduced at a clean committed revision
supporting.certify-pairs-a.json: all-pairs comparison, the run that did not exhibit the divergence
supporting.certify-pairs-b.json: all-pairs comparison, the run that did
supporting.certify-readme-sample.json: the run pasted verbatim in the README
supporting.upstream-finding.json: provenance index for vllm#51187; not a result artifact and carries no env of its own
supporting.prediction-rmsnorm-blocksize.json: pre-registration for the instrumented RMSNorm block-size run, committed before the run so its result cannot be fitted to it; not a result artifact and carries no env of its own
supporting.rmsnorm-blocksize.json: the mechanism behind vllm#51187, measured rather than inferred: num_tokens at every fused_add_rms_norm launch across 10 server lifetimes and 2 controls, against the prediction committed beforehand. The subject is a deliberately patched 0.26.0 and the artifact carries both the patched and stock digests
supporting.upstream-finding-server-flags.json: supersedes the server_flags field of upstream-finding.json, which omitted --dtype float16 and so was not replayable. The original is unedited; corrections in evidence/ are added, never applied in place
